z-m-12-11.title: Ibhokisi egqunyiweyo yi-A okanye yi-B?

z-m-12-11.thinking.2: Ukuthandabuza ingcinga yokuqala xa iziphumo zingahambelani nayo

z-m-12-07.title: I-1 m² ingaphi cm²?
z-m-12-07.topic: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwamacandelo endawo m² ne-cm²
z-m-12-07.goal: Qonda ukuba kutheni ubudlelwane phakathi kwamacandelo obude (1 m = 100 cm) bungenakuthunyelwa nje ngqo kumacandelo endawo, yenza ii-rectangle ezininzi ezinendawo ye-1 m² usebenzisa i-cm, uze ucacise ukuze umntakwenu omncinci aqonde.
z-m-12-07.material: Iklasi kaJiho ifuna ukwenza ikona yokufunda enendawo echanekileyo ye-1 m² kwelinye icala legumbi lokufundela. UJiho wathi, "I-1 m yi-100 cm, ngoko i-1 m² yi-100 cm²." Umntakwabo omncinci uHarin, osebanjini lesi-3, weva oku wabhideka. Amacandelo obude yi-cm ne-m, kwaye amacandelo endawo yi-cm² ne-m². (I-cm² ifundwa "isikwere sesentimitha," kwaye i-m² ifundwa "isikwere semitha.")
z-m-12-07.thinking.0: Ukufumana impazamo yokuthumela ubudlelwane bobude ngqo kwindawo
z-m-12-07.prereq.0: Ukufumana indawo yee-rectangle nezikwere (inqanaba lebanga lesi-4)
z-m-12-07.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwamacandelo obude i-cm ne-m
z-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: UJiho wayisombulula ngolu hlobo ngelixa ekucinga isikwere esinamacala e-1 m. Khetha umgca omnye ongachanekanga.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ngqo indawo yesikwere esinecala le-100 cm nge-cm uze uyithelekise nesigqibo sesisombululo.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.0: Cinga ngendawo eyisikwere enamacala e-1 m.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.2: Indawo yesikwere yi-(icala)×(icala), ngoko 1 m × 1 m = 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.3: I-1 m yi-100 cm, ngoko i-1 m² yi-100 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 awuchanekanga. Kubude, 1 m = 100 cm, kodwa kwindawo, 100 cm × 100 cm = 10000 cm². I-100 cm² yindawo nje yesikwere esinamacala e-10 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukwenza ikona yokufunda ibe yi-rectangle enendawo echanekileyo ye-1 m². Gqiba ububanzi nobude nge-cm uze ubufake. Ububanzi nobude zombini ziinani ezipheleleyo ukusuka kwi-40 cm ukuya kwi-250 cm, kwaye ukutshintsha ububanzi nobude kubalwa njengemilo efanayo, ngoko ibale kanye kuphela. Fumana iimilo ezi-3 ezahlukileyo.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ububanzi, uze ucinge, uguqulela kwi-m, ukuba ubude kufuneka bube yintoni ukuze ububanzi × ubude zibe yi-1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kwimibhityo oyifumeneyo, bhala imveliso yobubanzi nobude uze uhlole ukuba zonke ziyafana.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda ufake ububanzi nobude njengamanani emvelo.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ubuncinane yi-40 cm kwaye ubukhulu yi-250 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ububanzi nobude kufuneka zibe buncinane i-40 cm kwaye bubukhulu i-250 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Indawo ayiyi-1 m². Guqula ububanzi nobude zibe yi-m uze uziphindaphinde.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba indawo yi-1 m², yi-10000 kwii-cm². 100×100, 50×200, 80×125, kunye ne-40×250 zonke zihambelana nemiqathango (ukutshintshisa ububanzi nobude yimilo enye). Ezi zibhanxa apho imveliso yobubanzi nobude yi-10000.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.prompt: Chazela u-Harin ngendlela elula ukuba kutheni i-1 m² yi-10000 cm², hayi i-100 cm². U-Harin uyazi ukuphindaphinda neegridi ze-cm, kodwa iiyunithi zendawo zintsha kuye. Kulungile ukubhala ngokungathi uzoba umfanekiso ngamagama.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.0: Zama ukuqala ngokuthi u-Harin sele eyazi ntoni (ukuphindaphinda, iikwere ze-1 cm).
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuzalisa ikwere enemiphetho ye-1 m ngeekwere ze-1 cm, uze ubale ukuba zingaphi iikwere ezifaka kumgca omnye nokuba zingaphi imigca.

z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.1: Harin, cinga ukugquma ishiti enkulu yephepha eyi-1 m² ngamaqwebana amancinci ephepha elinemibala nganye yi-1 cm². Ama-100 afaka kumgca omnye, kwaye kukho imigca emi-100 enjalo. Ngama-100 kumgca ngamnye wemigca eli-100, kukho amaqwebana angama-10000 zonke, ngoko i-1 m² yi-10000 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.2: Indawo yekwere enobubanzi be-100 cm nokuphakama kwe-100 cm yi-100×100, eyi-10000 cm². Nangona ubude buphindwe ngama-100, ububanzi nokuphakama zombini ziphindwe ngama-100, ngoko indawo iba ngamaxesha ali-100×100.

z-m-12-02.title: Singayithemba indlela ka-Seoa yokwenza lula?
z-m-12-02.topic: Ukwenza amaqhezu obungakanani obufanayo nomgaqo wokunciphisa amaqhezu
z-m-12-02.goal: Vavanya ingcamango yokuba "ukwenza into efanayo kumxholo ongaphantsi nowongaphezulu" kugcina ubungakanani bufana, uze uchaze ukuba zeziphi iinkqubo ezigcina ubungakanani beqhezu kunye nemeko ekhethekileyo apho indlela ka-Seoa isebenza khona.

Ukunciphisa iqhezu kuthetha ukwenza umxholo ongaphantsi nowongaphezulu bube mncinci ngoxa ubungakanani beqhezu buhlala bunjalo. U-Seoa uyazi ukuba "ukuba wenza into efanayo kumxholo ongaphantsi nowongaphezulu, ubungakanani buhlala bunjalo." Masifumanise ukuba singalithemba na ilungu lika-Seoa.

z-m-12-02.thinking.2: Ukufumana imeko apho indlela isebenza khona ngengozi

Ekubeni obomvu abaphindwanga ngama-3 ayeloo, u-Mina ucinga ukuba uyilo lwalungalunganga. Yeyiphi indlela engcono yokubona?
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.0: Beka iziphumo zokukhupha okwali-10 ecaleni kwamanani akwibhokisi (6, 2, 2) uthi yintoni efanayo nenhlukileyo.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ukukhupha amaxesha ali-10 kwakhona kwibhokisi enye kuya kunika isiphumo esifanayo kanye na, uze uthelekise iziphumo zeeroundi ezimbini.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.a: Uyilo alulunganga. Ukuba kukho amabhola angama-6, 2, 2, amanani amaxesha akhutshiweyo nawo kufuneka abe ngama-6, 2, 2.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.a: Ucinge ukuba umlinganiselo wamanani amabhola kufuneka ubonakale ngqo, njengoko injalo, kumanani amaxesha akhutshiweyo.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.b: Uyilo lulunge. Kuba iyeloo yavela kancinci, iyeloo inethuba elikhulu lokuvela okulandelayo.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba ubuyisela amabhola uwaxube, iziphumo zangaphambili azitshintshi ukwenzeka okulandelayo, kodwa ucinge ukuba ziyatshintsha.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.c: Ukukhupha amaxesha ali-10 linani elincinci, ngoko linokuphambuka. Yandisa inani lokukhupha, yenza amaxesha amaninzi, uze uthelekise.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.c: Le yingcamango yokubona ukuba iziphumo zamathuba ambalwa zinokushukunyiswa lithuba, nokuzama ukujonga ngokunyusa inani lamathuba.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.d: Obomvu bavele kakhulu, ngoko kungqinisisiwe ukuba uyilo lulunge.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.d: Uqinisekise ukuba uyilo lulungile ngesiphumo sovavanyo olunye.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.explain: Ukwenzeka kokuba obomvu babe ngamaxesha ama-3 eyeloo kuthetha ukuba ithuba lokukhutshwa liphindwe ngama-3, hayi ukuba livela kanye ngamaxesha ama-3 ngakumbi (amaxesha ama-6 nama-2) kokukhupha okwali-10. Ngamathuba ambalwa, linokuphambuka ngenxa yethuba, kwaye ngokuphindaphinda okuninzi, ngokubanzi lisondela kumlinganiselo wamanani. Obomvu amaxesha ama-5 neyeloo amaxesha ama-3 siphumo esinokwenzeka kakuhle.
